MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 27.9% and mixed breadth, with 3/8 sectors positive. Selectivity remains warranted; neither volatility nor breadth signals a decisive risk-on or risk-off backdrop.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads (+8.70% 1W; +22.23% 1M), with KONTR (1W: +26.73% | 1M: +69.75%) ABOVE TREND. Transportation is next (+0.08% 1W; +16.43% 1M), led by THYAO (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +21.71%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Banking & Finance (-5.16% 1W) and Holding & Investment (-4.92%) are weakest; AKBNK (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -0.07%) and SAHOL (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -5.79%) are BELOW TREND. Energy & Chemicals also remains under pressure (-3.96% 1W; -11.00% 1M), with PETKM (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +26.73% | 1M: +69.75%) ABOVE TREND; VESTL (1W: +7.27% | 1M: -10.50%) RECOVERY; CCOLA (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +6.74%) ABOVE TREND. TOASO (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +2.85%) and BIMAS (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.05%) are also ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: -9.56% | 1M: -6.66%), SOKM (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -28.17%), PETKM (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -20.41%), ULKER (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -11.88%) and TRALT (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -11.17%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +26.73% | 1M: +69.75%) leads decisively, followed by VESTL (1W: +7.27% | 1M: -10.50%), CCOLA (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +6.74%), TOASO (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +2.85%) and BIMAS (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.05%). VESTL is a RECOVERY; the other four are ABOVE TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is the weakest sector on the week, down 5.16%; weakness is broad, with AKBNK (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -0.07%) and ISCTR (1W: -7.06% | 1M: -1.71%) BELOW TREND. GARAN (1W: -5.88% | 1M: +9.96%) and YKBNK (1W: -4.99% | 1M: +1.16%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is marginally positive for the week (+0.70%) but remains down 3.11% over the month, signaling mixed momentum. TOASO (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +2.85%) is ABOVE TREND, VESTL (1W: +7.27% | 1M: -10.50%) is in RECOVERY, and EREGL (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -12.41%) is BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector is weak, down 3.96% on the week and 11.00% over the month; PETKM (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -20.41%) and HEKTS (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -18.23%) are BELOW TREND. TUPRS (1W: -0.79% | 1M: -3.08%) and SISE (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -5.41%) are also BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral, selective stance: favor relative-strength leaders while keeping risk controlled given mixed breadth and ongoing sector weakness. Avoid treating short-term rebounds as confirmed reversals; VESTL (1W: +7.27% | 1M: -10.50%) remains in RECOVERY.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor KONTR (1W: +26.73% | 1M: +69.75%) ABOVE TREND and THYAO (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +21.71%) ABOVE TREND for continuation, alongside VESTL (1W: +7.27% | 1M: -10.50%) RECOVERY. Watch whether banking pressure stabilizes in GARAN (1W: -5.88% | 1M: +9.96%) CORRECTION and whether PETKM (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND finds support.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Technology & Telecom and Transportation remain the relative-strength leaders; monitor whether their gains broaden beyond current leaders. Banking & Finance and Energy & Chemicals warrant close attention for signs of stabilization after steep weekly losses.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels are provided in the data, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated. Watch volatility moving below 25% or above 40%, and breadth improving to at least 5/8 positive sectors—or weakening to 2/8 or fewer—as regime triggers.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market remains NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 27.9% and mixed breadth at 3/8 positive sectors. Technology & Telecom and Transportation offer relative strength, while banks and Energy & Chemicals are key downside risks; prioritize selective exposure and confirmation of broader participation.
